Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a faulty fallback rule that equated Maria of Aragon’s queenship of Portugal with her nationality and directed reporting her as Portuguese. This misapplies nationality (by birth/origin) to a marital title and ignored available evidence describing her as a Spanish (Aragonese) infanta, leading toward the wrong conclusion.
